text.zh: 作者随手写的整活项目 sb.h 意外出圈：先在小红书被评论区围攻，接着被 X 上的 hsn、雲鳩转发，还上了开源中国的公众号。作者对谩骂一笑置之，对开源中国只追热点有些失望，总结说：骂归骂，项目火了是真的。
text.en: sb.h, a joke project the author threw together, unexpectedly went viral: piled on in the comments on Xiaohongshu, reposted on X by hsn and 雲鳩, and picked up by OSChina's WeChat account. The author laughs off the abuse, is a little disappointed that OSChina only chases what's trending, and sums it up: they may be cursing it, but the project really did take off.
